description: VoiceLink carrier fixture: raw webhook bodies -> normalizeVoicelinkWebhook / parseVoicelinkWebhook / classifyVoicelinkOutcome. Every body is transcribed from a VoiceLink unit test; each entry's source field names it (file > test name). The fixture pins the carrier's payload shapes, so a change to the normaliser or classifier that alters any mapping reds its test.
parsedNullMeans: parseVoicelinkWebhook returned null (informational or unknown event)
classificationNullMeans: not a terminal event; classifyVoicelinkOutcome is not run
